name: real-codex-cli-adapter
head: f03fe43
plan: Add an LLM provider layer (src/core/llm): OpenRouter over fetch, plus claude and codex CLI adapters that shell out with --help feature detection, a shared spawnCli helper, config with defaults per provider, and a FakeProvider for tests. The codex adapter runs `codex exec` read-only against a PR checkout and must run in that checkout (or an empty temp dir when there is none), return the model's answer, and report token usage.
